description: The only way to give this round's answer. Fill the fields and call it; the platform builds and stores the answer from them. Do not write the answer as text.

parameters.body: Your answer to the person, in the person's language. It must not be empty.
parameters.ideas: [] or 2 to 3 options, each with a title and a detail. Give options only when the person has a real choice between different approaches; never give exactly one option and never more than three.
parameters.ideas[].title: One line of at most 120 characters.
parameters.goalCardDrafts: [] unless this request has no goal and the person asks for new work; then at least one draft. A draft is a proposal only; no goal exists until the person confirms it.
parameters.goalCardDrafts[].completion: A non-empty array of checkable completion criteria.
parameters.goalCardDrafts[].screening: Optional: omit it or use null when you did not screen the draft. Otherwise fill modules, size, conflictsWith, dependsOn, urgency, suggestedPosition and note.
parameters.goalCardDrafts[].screening.modules: The catalog module ids this draft uses, by bare moduleId; the platform fills each ModuleRef's projectId.
parameters.goalCardDrafts[].screening.conflictsWith: Goal ids this draft conflicts with, by bare goalId; the platform fills each GoalRef's aggregateType and projectId.
parameters.goalCardDrafts[].screening.dependsOn: Goal ids this draft depends on, by bare goalId; the platform fills each GoalRef's aggregateType and projectId.
